invariants.rationale: The method immediately returns false if container.hasParent() is true, otherwise it calls setContainerPosition and returns true.
Whenever result is true, container cannot have a parent; otherwise, it would have returned earlier.
If result is false, that can only occur if container.hasParent() is true.
If container does not have a parent, result must be true.
Direct encoding of return logic: returns false if container has a parent, true otherwise.
